body:
QUESTIONABLE / PROJECTION. Explicit 037b as-designed and fix rows now accompany the filed 040 common account. All 120 configurations carry 250 F / 30:1 scarf and 200 F / 30.341397:1 scarf rows; original 040 files remain unchanged.

As-designed field survival does not close minimum-strength free edges: minimum factor is about 0.830, versus typical-strength 1.163. Thus no strict as-designed solution exists within the four optimism axes. Conditional pricing relaxes only the edge feasibility filter, retains every failed safety factor and false pass flag, and reoptimizes the remaining shell/scarf constraints.

At R10 ISA the conditional as-designed payload is -154.130 kg versus -109.649 kg for the fix. At R30 ISA retained-floor it is 4,826.570 versus 6,100.222 kg; the first remains an edge failure despite positive payload.

The 037b +0.120151 kg repair applies to its original 028b geometry, not as a fixed charge at every size. All joining and residual-compression terms are recomputed. All 120 fixed payloads reproduce within 1e-8 kg; mass closure and remaining scalar modes pass. Installed SF unknown. MAINLINE-048 is underway.
